from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json

paths = [
    'products/distribution/catalogue-referral/item-4-operator-decision-pointer.json',
    'products/distribution/catalogue-referral/item-4-release-binding.json',
    'products/services/catalogue-commission-terms/terms-en-fr.md',
    'products/services/catalogue-inbound-cad/verified-merchant-replies-en-fr.json',
]
for name in paths:
    path = Path(name)
    record = {'path': name, 'present': path.is_file()}
    if path.is_file():
        content = path.read_bytes()
        record['sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
        if name.endswith('operator-decision-pointer.json'):
            record['public_operator_pointer'] = json.loads(content)
    print(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False))
